title: 2001 Leaf Rookies & Stars #70 Randy Moss Minnesota Vikings Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
Own a piece of NFL history with this 2001 Leaf Rookies & Stars sports trading card featuring the legendary Randy Moss. This card is a must-have for any Minnesota Vikings fan or football aficionado. With its iconic design and inclusion in the base set, this card is a valuable addition to any sports trading card collection.

Relive the excitement of Moss' impressive plays and unforgettable moments on the field without mentioning the card's condition. This Donruss-manufactured card has the card number 70 and belongs to the 2001 season. Add this gem to your collection today.
